Si vous vous inscrivez à nos nouvelles (: If you sign up for our news (in the footer or the small invitation window), we keep your email address, the language of the site and the date you signed up, in order to send you your welcome code and then, at most twice a month, our new places and gift ideas. Every email contains a one-click unsubscribe link. Legal basis: your consent. Retention: until you unsubscribe, and at most 3 years without any exchange.
Une dizaine de jours après la livraison,: About ten days after delivery, we send you a single email inviting you to rate the tiles you bought (legitimate interest: gathering our customers’ feedback). If you leave a review, your rating, comment, first name and town are published on the tile’s page, with the date. You can ask for your review to be deleted at any time through the contact form.
Si vous cochez, sur la page de paiement,: If you tick the box agreeing to receive news from K-Reau on the payment page and do not complete your order, we may send you an email allowing you to pick it up again. Ticking this box also signs you up for our news; you can unsubscribe at any time.
